replies.author: GrapeSmoothie
replies.body: Well no it doesn't. This map is going to be tested Saturday during the map testing event. Took me 10 months just to get Cavum I to be put in rotations and I spent 7-8 of those months as map developer. If the map doesn't test well then I can still revise it to make it better off of feedback given so if it isn't up to par then no it's not guaranteed to be put into rotations.
